title: Dungeon Escape
intro: You wake up on cold stone with a torch in your hand and 3 health points. Somewhere in this dungeon is a key, and beyond it, the way out.
win_text: You squeeze through the gate and run into the sunlight. You escaped!

torch.description: A flickering torch. It keeps the dark away.

sword.description: A rusty old sword, still sharp enough. Adds 2 damage in a fight.

potion.description: A small red bottle. Drinking it gives you back 2 health.

key.description: A heavy iron key with a dragon on the handle.

cell.name: Prison cell
cell.description: Damp straw covers the floor. The cell door hangs open on one rusty hinge.

corridor.name: Long corridor
corridor.description: Water drips down the stone walls. Doorways open off in every direction.

armory.name: Old armory
armory.description: Racks of broken spears and dented shields line the walls.

storeroom.name: Storeroom
storeroom.description: Sacks of rotten grain are piled up next to some broken barrels.

guardroom.name: Guard room
guardroom.description: A wooden table is covered in playing cards and chicken bones.

hall.name: Dragon's hall
hall.description: The ceiling is lost in smoke. Gold coins crunch under your feet.

gate.name: The great gate
gate.description: A huge iron gate blocks the tunnel. Daylight shines through the bars.

outside.name: Outside
outside.description: Fresh air! Green hills stretch away in the sunshine.
